description: Checks Storage contract metadata against storage rules and tests.

rules.title: Storage path contracts stay tied to rules and rules tests
rules.instruction: Every storage path schema must declare x-storage-rules-match, x-storage-read, x-storage-write, x-storage-rules-test-file, and matching storage.rules coverage. Review passes for storage contracts should run the static storage checker and, when feasible, the firestore/storage emulator rules suite.
